comparabilityDiagnosis.deployedSetBehavior: canonical_photo_intelligence_set_v1 derives high set comparability from five exact pose/view matches and zero unmatched views. It does not model metric-specific claim applicability.
comparabilityDiagnosis.legacyBehavior: Legacy source analyses describe global pose/view comparability and then emit directional observations. Camera scale, lighting, pump and rear arm/scapular geometry are not carried as enforceable observation-specific gates.
comparabilityDiagnosis.candidateBehavior: Each observation records rating, applicable claims, compromised claims and rationale. Global capture dimensions remain separate. Small apparent differences must receive more confidence penalty from capture differences.
comparabilityDiagnosis.importantDistinction: A pair can support broad stability or no obvious deterioration while remaining limited for subtle waist-width, taper, circumference, definition or muscle-size direction.
